title: StableJudge: A Lightweight Adversarial Defense Framework for LLM-as-a-Judge
abstract: arXiv:2610.16814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges to assign scalar scores that drive downstream decision-making, including tasks such as paper review and recommendation. However, LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines are vulnerable to score-hijacking prompt injection embedded in evaluated content, which corrupts scoring signals and distorts induced rankings. Existing defenses often enforce robustness by modifying the judge model itself, making safety dependent on a specific model's scale and training and requiring repeated effort when the judge is updated or replaced. We propose StableJudge, a lightweight defense framework that externalizes prompt-injection mitigation as a reusable pre-scoring capability. StableJudge centers on a compact 0.13B Sentry that localizes injected spans and performs targeted sanitization prior to evaluation, and is trained using adversarially evolving attacks to improve robustness beyond a fixed prompt set. translated_title: StableJudge：面向大语言模型评审的轻量级对抗防御框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作评审者，通过给出标量分数来驱动下游决策，包括论文评审与推荐等任务。然而，LLM-as-a-Judge 流水线容易受到嵌入在被评估内容中的“分数劫持”提示注入攻击，这会破坏评分信号并扭曲由此产生的排名。现有防御方法通常通过修改评审模型本身来实现鲁棒性，这使得安全性依赖于特定模型的规模与训练，并且在评审模型更新或更换时需要重复投入。我们提出 StableJudge，这是一个轻量级防御框架，它将提示注入缓解外化为一种可复用的评分前处理能力。StableJudge 的核心是一个紧凑的 0.13B 参数 Sentry 模型，它在评估之前定位被注入的片段并执行针对性清理，并通过对抗性演化攻击进行训练，以获得超越固定提示集合的鲁棒性。
tldr: StableJudge 提出将提示注入防御从评审模型中解耦出来，利用一个仅 0.13B 参数的紧凑 Sentry 模型在评分前定位并清理被评估内容中的恶意注入片段，从而形成一个与评审模型无关、可复用的轻量级评分前防御能力。
en_tdlr: StableJudge externalizes prompt-injection mitigation as a reusable pre-scoring capability, using a compact 0.13B Sentry model trained on adversarially evolving attacks to localize and sanitize injected spans before LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, independent of the judge model itself.
